title: Serve the owner's tuned model role by role, only where it measured better
request: Phases 4 and 5: the trained model behind the gateway, in shadow first, switched role by role only on evidence; switching it off restores the earlier model.
spec: dclab_rnd/models/tuned.py: plan (what a role still needs), shadow/unshadow, promote and retire, each the routing's audited switch; a command; tests.
plan: Reuse routing.switch: no new rule decides who serves.
Say what is missing before a promotion instead of only refusing it.
Test the whole way: shadow, refused without the suite, refused without a better measurement, promoted, retired.

decisions.decision: The module is a thin path over models/routing.py, not a second switch.
decisions.why: 21.4 and 21.5 already hold the rules (reviewer and reason, the harness suite, measured better for an understanding role, local-only shadows); a second switch could disagree with them.

decisions.decision: promote refuses while plan lists anything missing, before the routing's own rules run.
decisions.why: routing.change never looks at the shadow: shadow first had to be enforced here, or a model that never shadowed (or a remote one) could serve.

decisions.decision: retire puts back the tier that served before the tuned model, while its approval holds, as the owner's audited override; otherwise the role's own tier.
decisions.why: Switching off must restore the earlier model, and the earlier model's measurement did not include the tuned one, so the rules alone would refuse it.

change: dclab_rnd/models/tuned.py, tests/test_tuned_serving.py, the plan's status, TRAINING.md's runbook, CLAUDE.md.

findings.defect: The first draft of plan read the shadow log through a method it does not have.
findings.scenario: plan on a workspace with shadowed requests reported none.
findings.cause: The shadow log's reader is rows(), not read(); a hasattr guard hid the mistake by returning an empty list.
findings.fix: plan reads open_shadows(home).rows() for the purpose and keeps the tuned model's agreement only.

findings.defect: promote did not require the tuned model to have shadowed the role.
findings.scenario: A fresh workspace with the suite passed and no shadow: promote served the tuned model, a remote endpoint too.
findings.cause: routing.change checks the suite and the measurement, never the shadow.
findings.fix: promote computes plan and refuses with what is missing.

findings.defect: plan reported the tuned model as serving after it was swapped for another.
findings.scenario: Promote dclab-solver-8b, then set DCLAB_TIER_TUNED_MODEL to a v2: plan said serving and ready while the gateway served the role's own model.
findings.cause: plan read only the routed tier, not whether its approval still held.
findings.fix: serving needs routing.approved; otherwise the stale approval is listed as missing.

findings.defect: retire always went back to the role's own tier.
findings.scenario: A reviewer moved a role to strong, the tuned model replaced it, retire: the role went to standard, not strong.
findings.fix: retire reads the history for the tier before the tuned one and restores it while its approval holds.

findings.defect: ready was true with only failed shadow requests, and for an understanding role while promote would refuse.
findings.scenario: Three shadow rows all with outcome error gave ready true.
findings.cause: ready counted requests, not answers, and folded the measurement into missing.
findings.fix: a shadow that only failed is missing; needs_measurement is reported apart from ready.

findings.scenario: --measured dclab-solver (no =) raised ValueError with a traceback.
findings.fix: each pair is checked and refused as model=score.

outcome: The path to serve a tuned model exists and every step is audited; no role is switched yet because no tuned model exists yet (the training run is the owner's).
lessons: A defensive hasattr around an API you are not sure of turns a wrong name into silent emptiness: read the interface instead.
A thin wrapper over existing rules still owns the rules its docstring promises: if the wrapped function does not check something, the wrapper must.
risks: The harness suite must be run with the tuned tier serving the role before a promotion; that run needs the model on this machine.
